the-common-house.setup: python3 --version; test -f README.md; test -f docs/design/README.md; python3 -m json.tool docs/import-provenance.json > /dev/null
the-common-house.test:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
files = [root / "README.md", *sorted((root / "docs").rglob("*.md"))]
assert len(files) >= 12, "Expected repository README and design pack"
links = 0
errors = []
for path in files:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if not text.strip():
        errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(root)}: empty document")
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\s)]+)\)", text):
        url = urlsplit(target)
        if url.scheme or url.netloc or not url.path:
            continue
        dest = (path.parent / unquote(url.path)).resolve()
        links += 1
        if not dest.is_relative_to(root) or not dest.is_file():
            errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(root)}: missing or unsafe target {target}")
assert not errors, "\n".join(errors)
print(f"PASS: {len(files)} nonempty Markdown documents; {links} local file links")
'
